title: Arithmetic progressions in a random set on a budget
summary: A restricted-budget version of the random graph process, introduced by Frieze, Krivelevich, and Michaeli in 2025, studies the construction of structures by an online player who can purchase only a limited number of random edges. In this paper, we transfer this framework from random graphs to random subsets of integers, focusing on the construction of $k$-term arithmetic progressions. A player, Builder, is presented with a sequence of $t$ integers drawn uniformly at random from $[n]$.
